visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair in a navy and white striped polo shirt holds up a plastic bottle of milky rice wine. A split screen shows a large seafood pancake being sliced with metal scissors on a grey table. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor urban street under a cloudy sky, showing the white and black sign of a restaurant called 'Chojo Kalguksu'. Cars are parked along the wet street. (3) Back inside, the man holds a white menu card with photos of food. He then points excitedly towards a large bowl of noodle soup with green vegetables. (4) The man is seen eating a piece of seafood pancake and then slurping noodles from a smaller bowl. Various side dishes like red kimchi and dipping sauces are scattered around the main dishes. (5) A close-up shot features a steaming metal pot packed with clams and topped with shredded green onions. The man uses a ladle to serve the clear broth into his bowl. (6) The man continues to eat and talk directly to the camera while sitting at the restaurant table. The background shows other diners and the bright, clean interior of the establishment.
